headline: On October 16, 2002: Bibliotheca Alexandrina opens in Egypt
captionCards: Modern library with 2 million books capacity
Promotes global cultural and intellectual exchange
instagramCaption:
Bibliotheca Alexandrina opens, reviving ancient Alexandria's legacy. \nThe new library and cultural center opened on the Mediterranean shore in Alexandria, Egypt, commemorating the ancient Library of Alexandria, once one of the largest libraries in the world. The modern library aims to be a center for learning and dialogue, with a vast collection and state-of-the-art facilities. It continues to be a symbol of knowledge and cultural exchange. \nWhy do you think it's important to preserve and celebrate historical legacies? \\[Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳]
